Rice Flour Muffins
By: Anonymous
Published: Saturday, December 12, 2009 - 11:24pm

Ingredients




1 cup rice flour
2 teaspoons baking powder
Pinch of salt
1/2 cup ground oats
1/4 cup honey
1/4 cup sesame oil
1 cup soy milk
2 eggs
1/4 cup nuts, ground
1/2 cup raisins or fresh blueberries

Preparation

1 Combine all dry ingredients in one bowl. Mix wet ingredients in another bowl. Lightly oil and flour a 12 hole muffin tin. Preheat oven to 425 degrees. Mix contents of two bowls and spoon into muffin tins. Place in oven and bake for 20 minutes.
